<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0609-44-16" status="reviewed"><lb edRef="inst:4652" n="198a5"/> || <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8622">'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud</rs> las <quote>
         
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog <choice><corr>lo</corr><orig>la</orig></choice> tsha ba</rs> lung bstan pa ni || 
				<lg>
				<l xml:space="preserve">°sngon <expan>sems can</expan> <expan>thams cad</expan> la ||</l>
				<l>gtang dka'i 'dog ba ma lus btang ||</l> 
				<l>bya dga' mi bzad de yang byas ||</l> 
				<l>de'i phyi ngan pa? sangs rgyas ||</l> 
				<l>'di nas <rs type="place">byang phyogs gangs</rs> 'gram du ||</l> 
				<l>nga'i bstan pa 'dzin brtson pa || </l>
				<l>blo ldan gang dag 'byung 'gyur ba ||</l> 
				<l>de ni shes rab mtha' gnas ming || </l>
				<l>yi ge sgra bshad byas pa las || </l>
				<l>blo gros thogs pa myed pa 'byung </l>
         </lg>
		</quote> zhes so || || </seg></TEI>
